# Cleanroom FFU

> > Eawayfilter is a China-based manufacturer of custom HEPA filters, fan filter units, and HVAC air filtration solutions for cleanrooms, pharmaceutical labs, and industrial applications.

Cleanroom FFU specializes in designing and manufacturing high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters and cleanroom equipment with OEM/ODM capabilities. The company offers rapid prototyping, low minimum order quantities, and customization across multiple filter types and specifications for diverse industries including pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and cleanroom environments.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filters (H13, H14, U15)
- Fan Filter Units (FFU)
- Custom filter manufacturing
- OEM/ODM services
- HVAC air filtration
- Cleanroom equipment
- Filter prototyping
- Gel-sealed filters
- Pleated filters
- Air purification
- Pharmaceutical-grade filtration
- Stainless steel frames
- Filter efficiency standards
- Low MOQ production
- 3D printing prototypes

## Custom HEPA Filter Solutions

- [Custom HEPA filter, 100% according to your specification](https://www.cleanroom-ffu.com/custom-hepa-filter): Custom HEPA filters for air purifiers, 3D printers, and HVAC systems
- [Custom round HEPA filter / activated carbon filter](https://www.cleanroom-ffu.com/custom-round-hepa-carbon-filter): OEM round HEPA and carbon filters (H13, H14, F5, MERV11)
- [Custom Cylinder HEPA Filter --- To get whatever you want !!!](https://www.cleanroom-ffu.com/custom-cylinder-hepa-filter): Cylindrical HEPA filter manufacturing with 3D printing prototypes
- [HEPA filter Prototype, Fast time and One Piece OK](https://www.cleanroom-ffu.com/hepa-filter-prototype): Fast HEPA filter prototyping for projects with various materials
- [Custom Air filter Manufacturer - Low cost and Small MOQ](https://www.cleanroom-ffu.com/customized-air-filters): Custom air filter manufacturing with low MOQ and design services
